status: criteria recorded before any v5r2 development predictions
rules: Use schema-valid accepted action sets, with exact action labels only when no allowed set exists. Training loss is not a deployment criterion.
Reject a new checkpoint for deployment if it introduces an invalid-output or threat-priority regression relative to v4r1 on the fixed development inputs.
Compare each formerly accepted development action that becomes rejected, not merely aggregate score. Record the practical severity before selecting.
Prioritize actual food-state understanding, tool prerequisites, feasible resource recovery and refusal of unavailable tasks. Report each slice denominator.
Exact live probes are diagnostic only. Ambiguous wood/plank stage probes have no hard gold label and do not enter the aggregate score.
Prefer retaining v4r1 if no new checkpoint has a defensible behavior advantage. A selected new checkpoint authorizes only a bounded live trial, not a claim of survival or Nether completion.
Original20 endpoint checks occur only after checkpoint selection and do not tune this run. Prior repeated use and root's incidental earlier label exposure limit claims of an untouched holdout.

The real acceptance requires local Qwen selecting actions, Mineflayer executing with server-confirmed effects, inventory/tool progression and survival. No manual progression, cheats or silent substitution of base outputs.
